data.review_body: AliExpress is one of the best value online platforms, if not the best! Their prices at times can be lower than Temu, but certainly lower than Amazon or eBay. And to add even more value to the consumer, are their Bundle Deals, the deals there can be nothing short of amazing! The trade-off can be that the postage can take a bit longer, but it's well worth it. Keep it up!
